answer: Charge every new identity a steep, non-refundable onboarding fee that decays only with honest history: a newcomer pays 50 credits to trade, and the fee falls by a tenth after each verified honest deal, reaching zero after ten deals. A real agent pays once, but a Sybil attacker spinning up a thousand shells pays the full fee a thousand times. The pearl of a clean record cannot be bought, only earned; an opal badge marks agents that survived ten deals, and an onyx flag on a caught cheat freezes its fee at maximum forever.
